findings.summary: Public deposit destination is marked TEST_ONLY/PRE-LIVE; warning says never send real funds.
Admin profile Last Login shows 1/1/1970 despite a current non-revoked session created and used on 2026-11-22.
Transfer confirmation remains disabled at amount 0 with no visible reason.

Public Spot trade history shows UNKNOWN for an actual filled BTCUSDT trade while Wallet Activity shows the related settlement Completed; saved as UI contract failure, source root cause not yet investigated.

Public Spot allows a Sell Limit quantity far above available BTC into a Review dialog with Confirm enabled and no visible insufficient-balance warning. Confirm was not activated; backend rejection is untested.

Admin says no global Binary policy is saved and exposes blank payout/stake controls while Public Options renders active 85% payout, 1–1000 USDT limits and all five durations. Admin pair Inspect states the shared global settings control these values. No setting was changed; backend source of effective values remains unverified.

The insufficient-balance transfer UI did not show an actionable insufficient-balance rejection. The submitted request received HTTP 401; the UI remained unresolved after Recheck and blocks repeat. Public activity returned empty and refreshed Admin/Public balances were unchanged; the specific business validation path remains unproven.

A 30-second SHORT position settled LOSS in Admin/Public Activity at 21:42:50 UTC, but the Public live Active-trades view kept showing Settling/Result pending through 21:46:50. It showed the terminal Loss only after navigating away and returning. Same position/profile was reconciled; no retry or correction was made.

A newly submitted 1 USDT isolated LONG 2x remained PENDING rather than reaching an active state with close/interest controls. Public UI pending-cancel returned CLOSED and repayment posting 839702c8-b3ab-4186-9087-533a53eb60f4; Public Activity and refreshed Admin Profile 757621 balances reconcile (989.9800000000000643 available / 20.019999999999935697 locked). Existing 10 USDT PENDING position preserved. Active close, interest and liquidation remain untested.

workflow_steps.name: Resume and reconcile
workflow_steps.method: Read the current tracker/manifest and compatible evidence; preserve existing outcomes and exact browser session.

workflow_steps.name: Map and prioritize
workflow_steps.method: Use the existing 113 criterion IDs and 18 journey definitions; prioritize authenticated read-only P0/P1 coverage, then responsive/accessibility and remaining nonfinancial criteria.

workflow_steps.name: Execute criterion
workflow_steps.method: Capture precondition, perform one semantic UI action sequence, assert the observable result, and collect the cheapest sufficient evidence. Serialize state-changing interactions; batch only independent reads.

workflow_steps.name: Reconcile data
workflow_steps.method: For API/data criteria, correlate Public projection with Admin/Backend durable readback where applicable. HTTP 200/toast/activity status alone is not economic finality.

workflow_steps.name: Review visual/mobile
workflow_steps.method: For responsive criteria inspect reflow, overflow, short-height usability, focus, labels, touch targets and safe-area styling; capture one screenshot per useful state and record device emulation facts.

workflow_steps.name: Triage failures
workflow_steps.method: Identify exact layer and operation, preserve evidence, make at most one safe supported retry, then record blocker/failure and continue unrelated authorized work.

workflow_steps.name: Record and reconcile
workflow_steps.method: Append criterion JSON and JSONL event using ID/precondition/action/UI result/network or state evidence/status/evidence path; atomically update only changed tracker rows, counts and tracker hash.

workflow_steps.name: Close frontier
workflow_steps.method: Report CONFIRMED, EXECUTED, PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED and NOT_TESTED separately; retain smallest remaining authorized frontier.

status_rules.PASS: all required observable outcomes for that criterion are evidenced
status_rules.FAIL: a required outcome is contradicted by observed evidence
status_rules.BLOCKED: required evidence/action is unavailable or outside authorization
status_rules.NOT_TESTED: criterion has not been executed to its acceptance contract

scope.financial_operations: require a specific current owner approval before action
scope.wallet_signature: owner handles through MetaMask; never simulate or request secrets
scope.source_changes: not part of this workflow setup

failure_recovery.browser_failure: preserve browser profile/session; no competing browser; inspect supported recovery and continue independent read-only work

skill_methods.qa_release: journey mapping, risk-based regression selection, UI/API/ledger reconciliation, responsive review and evidence-based failure triage integrated from the user-provided acceptance brief
skill_methods.web_mobile: real browser interaction and responsive/short-height review integrated into the same criteria queue
skill_methods.ui_ux: visible hierarchy, control labels, focus, touch-target, value readability and state feedback assessed only against rendered evidence
skill_methods.engineering_suite: native browser testing and bounded debugging/recovery methods applied
skill_methods.selective_intelligence: preserve resumed state, avoid duplicate work and separate proof from inference
skill_methods.annotations_extensibility: available only for a specific annotation-control integration or requested annotation feedback; no product annotation changes in this acceptance run
skill_methods.exa: official W3C WCAG 2.2 Reflow and Target Size guidance located for responsive/accessibility acceptance
